description: A permanent child's program opens a region, spawns a task into it, joins the task and closes the region. Every generation creates `r` and `w` under its own name, sup.s/c.s#1/r and sup.s/c.s#1/w, then sup.s/c.s#2/r and sup.s/c.s#2/w after the replacement, so the names do not repeat across restarts and the region reference of the spawn and of the close is scoped like the names (DSL 3.8).
